analyst_view.overall: Early view: with a month to go, Copenhagen (6th, seven points) host league-phase leaders Lugano (nine points, 11 goals) on matchday 5. Copenhagen are second in Denmark and beat Braga 3-0 at Parken; Lugano have scored at least three in every game and led the Swiss league in the latest table I read. The site makes Copenhagen clear favourites; on European form I would see it closer.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.7 goals. I lean higher: Lugano's three games have had 5, 7 and 3 goals, and Copenhagen's have had 3, 4 and 3. Two attacking sides near the top of the table should produce an open game.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners, 5.8 for Copenhagen. I read nothing about either side's style that moves this.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.2 cards, quite high already, with Lugano expected to take more. No referee is known this far out, so I stay with the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.1 shots. An open game would support this; I see nothing to move it.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target. Lugano's finishing has been sharp, which fits the number.
